feedback: I want to make my blue avatar have a really cool laser boots instead of the normal gun boots we currently have

selection.reason: The visual appearance of the player's boots and the projectiles (changing from normal gun boots to laser boots) is handled in the draw function, which contains both the rendering logic and likely the player/projectile update logic.

patch.notes: Replaced the gun boot functionality with laser boots. Shooting now spawns two high-speed laser beams from either side of the player's width, which are rendered with a glowing cyan effect. The player sprite also now features visually distinct cyan laser boots, and the ammo meter matches the new laser coloration.
